quote: What a way to kill one of the most successful video game franchises, make it feel nothing like the previous games.

author: Gamepyro
quote: I would have absolutely no problems with this game if they called it relationship crimes or something. I wouldn’t buy it and I wouldn’t play it. But they stuck GRAND THEFT AUTO on it, that’s their flagship game and this is what they gave us? Doesn’t feel like a grand theft auto game. Sad day, they killed a great franchise. All our chips are on the table for new skyrim as fallout. Sorry boys, it was a great run but grand theft auto is no more.
